H1201.et: from an unused root meaning to stink
H1201.def: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Basha, a king of Israel:--Baasha.

H1202.et: from (06213) and (03050) with a prepositional prefix
H1202.def: from «06213» and «03050» with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baasejah, an Israelite:--Baaseiah.

H1203.et: from (06251) (as sing. of (06252)) with a prepositional prefix
H1203.def: from «06251» (as singular of «06252») with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan:--Beeshterah.

H1204.def: a primitive root; to fear:--affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.

H1206.def: probably the same as «0948»; mud (as whitish clay):--mire.

H1207.def: intensive from «01206»; a swamp:--fen, mire(-ry place).

H1208.def: from «01219»; inaccessible, i.e. lofty:--vintage (by confusion with «01210»).

H1209.def: perhaps the same as «01153»; Betsai, the name of two Israelites:--Bezai.

H1210.def: from «01219»; clipped, i.e. the grape crop:--vintage.

H1211.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel
H1211.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion:--onion.

H1212.et: probably from (06738) and (0410) with a prepositional prefix
H1212.def: probably from «06738» and «0410» with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God; Betsalel, the name of two Israelites:--Bezaleel.

H1213.def: or Batsliyth {bats-leeth'}; from the same as «01211»; a peeling; Batsluth or Batslith, an Israelite:--Bazlith, Bazluth.

H1214.def: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder; figuratively, to finish, or (intransitively) stop:--(be) covet(- ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded.

H1215.def: from «01214»; plunder; by extension, gain (usually unjust):--covetousness, (dishonest) gain, lucre, profit.

H1216.def: a primitive root; perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister:--swell.

H1217.def: from «01216»; dough (as swelling by fermentation):--dough, flour.

H1218.def: from «01216»; a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine:--Bozcath, Boskath.

H1219.def: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from «01210») to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification):--cut off, (de-)fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.

H1220.def: from «01219»; strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out):--gold defence.

H1221.def: the same as «01220», an inaccessible spot; Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite:--Bezer.

H1223.def: feminine from «01219»; an enclosure, i.e. sheep fold:--Bozrah.

H1224.def: the same as «01223»; Botsrah, a place in Edom:--Bozrah.

H1226.def: feminine intensive from «01219»; restraint (of rain), i.e. drought:--dearth, drought.

H1227.def: the same as «01228»; Bakbuk, one of the Nethinim:--Bakbuk.

H1228.def: from «01238»; a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying):--bottle, cruse.

H1229.def: from «01228» and «03050»; emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah; Bakbukjah, an Israelite:--Bakbukiah.

H1230.def: reduplicated from «01239»; searcher; Bakbakkar, an Israelite:--Bakbakkar.

H1231.def: from «01238»; wasteful; Bukki, the name of two Israelites:--Bukki.

H1232.def: from «01238» and «03050»; wasting of Jah; Bukkijah, an Israelite:--Bukkiah.

H1234.def: a primitive root; to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open:--make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.

H1235.def: from «01234»; a section (half) of a shekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin):--bekah, half a shekel.

H1237.def: from «01234»; properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains:--plain, valley.

H1238.def: a primitive root; to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine):--(make) empty (out), fail, × utterly, make void.

H1239.def: a primitive root; properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider:--(make) inquire (-ry), (make) search, seek out.

H1241.def: from «01239»; beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd:-- beeve, bull (+ -ock), + calf, + cow, great (cattle), + heifer, herd, kine, ox.

H1242.def: from «01239»; properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning:--(+) day, early, morning, morrow.

H1243.def: intensive from «01239»; a looking after:--seek out.

H1244.def: from «01239»; properly, examination, i.e. (by implication) punishment:--scourged.

H1245.def: a primitive root; to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after:--ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).

H1247.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01121»; a son, grandson, etc.:--X old, son.

H1248.def: borrowed (as a title) from «01247»; the heir (apparent to the throne):--son.

H1249.def: from «01305» (in its various senses); beloved; also pure, empty:--choice, clean, clear, pure.

H1250.def: or bar {bar}; from «01305» (in the sense of winnowing); grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extens. the open country:--corn, wheat.

H1253.def: the same as «01252»; vegetable lye (from its cleansing); used as a soap for washing, or a flux for metals:--X never so, purely.

H1254.def: a primitive root; (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes):-- choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).

H1255.def: a variation of «04757»; Berodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king:--Berodach-baladan.Birliy.

H1256.def: from «01254» and «08050»; Jah has created; Berajah, an Israelite:--Beraiah.

H1257.def: by reduplication from «01250»; a fowl (as fattened on grain):--fowl.

H1260.def: from «01258»; hail; Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite:--Bered.

H1262.def: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from «01250») to feed; also (as equivalent to «01305») to render clear (Eccl. 3:18):--choose, (cause to) eat, manifest, (give) meat.

H1263.def: passive participle from «01288»; blessed; Baruk, the name of three Israelites:--Baruch.

H1264.def: probably of foreign origin; damask (stuff of variegated thread):--rich apparel.

H1265.def: of uncertain derivation; a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood):--fir (tree).

H1266.def: a variation of «01265»; the cypress (or some elastic tree):--fir.

H1268.def: or Berothay {bay-ro-that'-ee}; probably from «01266»; cypress or cypresslike; Berothah or Berothai, a place north of Palestine:--Berothah, Berothai.

H1269.et: probably fem. pl. from an unused root
H1269.def: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes; Birzoth, an Israelite:--Birzavith (from the marg.).

H1270.def: perhaps from the root of «01269»; iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement:--(ax) head, iron.

H1271.def: from «01270»; iron-hearted; Barzillai, the name of three Israelites:--Barzillai.

H1272.def: a primitive root; to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly:--chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.

H1273.def: by transposition for «0978»; a Barchumite, or native of Bachurim:--Barhumite.

H1275.def: probably by contraction from «0882»; Beri, an Israelite:--Beri.

H1276.def: of uncertain derivation; (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine:--Berites.

H1277.def: from «01254» (in the sense of «01262»); fatted or plump:--fat ((fleshed), -ter), fed, firm, plenteous, rank.

H1278.def: feminine from «01254»; a creation, i.e. a novelty:--new thing.

H1281.def: or (shortened) bariach {baw-ree'-akh}; from «01272»; a fugitive, i.e. the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name:--crooked, noble, piercing.

H1282.def: the same as «01281»; Bariach, an Israelite:--Bariah.

H1283.et: apparently from the fem. of (07451) with a prepositional prefix
H1283.def: apparently from the feminine of «07451» with a prepositional prefix; in trouble; Beriah, the name of four Israelites:-- Beriah.

H1284.def: patronymically from «01283»; a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah:--Beerites.

H1285.def: from «01262» (in the sense of cutting (like «01254»)); a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh):--confederacy, (con-)feder(-ate), covenant, league.

H1286.def: the same as «01285»; Berith, a Shechemitish deity:--Berith.

H1288.def: a primitive root; to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason):--X abundantly, × altogether, × at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, × greatly, × indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, × still, thank.

H1292.def: from «01288» and «0410», God has blessed; Barakel, the father of one of Job's friends:--Barachel.

H1293.def: from «01288»; benediction; by implication prosperity:--blessing, liberal, pool, present.

H1294.def: the same as «01293»; Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine:--Berachah.

H1295.def: from «01288»; a reservoir (at which camels kneel as a resting-place):--(fish-)pool.

H1296.def: or Berekyahuw {beh-rek-yaw'-hoo}; from «01290» and «03050»; knee (i.e. blessing) of Jah; Berekjah, the name of six Israelites:--Berachiah, Berechiah.

H1297.et: perhaps from (07313) with a prepositional prefix
H1297.def: (Aramaic) perhaps from «07313» with a prepositional prefix; properly, highly, i.e. surely; but used adversatively, however:--but, nevertheless, yet.

H1298.def: of uncertain derivation; Bera, a Sodomitish king:--Bera.

H1299.def: a primitive root; to lighten (lightning):--cast forth.
